changes-requested.description: A reviewer asked for changes; the author owns the next move.

qa-failed.description: QA found a defect; the change goes back to the author.

blocked.description: Cannot proceed until something outside this change is resolved.

do-not-merge.description: Must not merge, whatever the checks say.

bug.description: Fixes behaviour that is wrong today.

feature.description: Adds behaviour that did not exist.

needs-qa.description: QA must sign this change off before it merges.

skip-qa.description: QA is not required, with the reason stated on the change.

qa-approved.description: QA signed off. Never applied by automation.

qa-self-verified.description: The agent verified its own work under the documented self-QA exception.

in-progress.description: An agent holds an active claim on this change.

ci-monitoring.description: A finished run still owes a CI-result comment. Not a claim.

needs-design.description: The flow and its states must be settled before the code is written.

design-approved.description: The design was reviewed and accepted by a named authority.

risk-low.description: Contained; a mistake is cheap to undo.

risk-medium.description: Affects a shared surface; reversible with effort.

risk-high.description: Hard to undo, or affects data, security or a public contract.

design.description: Waiting for a design review of the proposed screens.

design-failed.description: The design review found problems; rework the design.

skip-design.description: Rendered output is unchanged; no design review needed. State why in the PR.
